questions.question: After hearing about which incarnation of the Lord did Vidura beg Maitreya to narrate further transcendental activities?
questions.explanation: "After hearing from the great sage Maitreya about the Lord's incarnation as Varaha, Vidura, who had taken a vow, begged him with folded hands to please narrate further transcendental activities of the Lord..." (SB 3.14.1)

questions.question: According to Vidura, who was the original demon slain by Lord Boar?
questions.explanation: "I have heard by disciplic succession that Hiranyaksa, the original demon, was slain by the same form of sacrifices, the Personality of Godhead [Lord Boar]." (SB 3.14.2)

questions.question: The son of King Uttanapada, who ascended to the abode of the Lord placing his feet over the head of death, was who?
questions.explanation: "...the son of King Uttanapada [Dhruva] was enlightened regarding the Personality of Godhead, and he ascended to the abode of the Lord, placing his feet over the head of death." (SB 3.14.6)

questions.question: Who was Diti's father?
questions.explanation: "Diti, daughter of Daksa, being afflicted with sex desire, begged her husband, Kasyapa, the son of Marici, to have intercourse with her..." (SB 3.14.8)

questions.question: At what time of day did Diti beg Kasyapa to have intercourse with her in order to beget a child?
questions.explanation: "...begged her husband, Kasyapa, the son of Marici, to have intercourse with her in the evening in order to beget a child." (SB 3.14.8)

questions.question: When Diti approached Kasyapa, what was the sage doing?

options.text: Sitting in trance after offering oblations to Vishnu
Performing a fire sacrifice for the demigods

questions.explanation: "The sun was setting, and the sage was sitting in trance after offering oblations to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Vishnu, whose tongue is the sacrificial fire." (SB 3.14.9)

questions.question: How many of his daughters did Daksa hand over to Kasyapa?
questions.explanation: "Our well-wishing father, Daksa...handed over thirteen of his daughters unto you, and since then we have all been faithful." (SB 3.14.14)

questions.question: Kasyapa compared crossing the dangerous situation of the material ocean to crossing the ocean with what?
questions.explanation: "As one can cross over the ocean with seagoing vessels, one can cross the dangerous situation of the material ocean by living with a wife." (SB 3.14.18)

questions.question: Why did Kasyapa describe the particular evening time as most inauspicious?

options.text: Because the horrible-looking ghosts and companions of the lord of the ghosts are visible
Because the Vedas forbade all activity

questions.explanation: "This particular time is most inauspicious because at this time the horrible-looking ghosts and constant companions of the lord of the ghosts are visible." (SB 3.14.23)

questions.question: Who travels at that evening time on the back of his bull carrier, accompanied by ghosts?
questions.explanation: "Lord Siva, the king of the ghosts, sitting on the back of his bull carrier, travels at this time, accompanied by ghosts who follow him for their welfare." (SB 3.14.24)

questions.question: What is the relationship of Lord Siva to Diti's husband Kasyapa?

options.text: He is the younger brother of her husband

questions.explanation: "He is the younger brother of your husband, and he sees with his three eyes." (SB 3.14.25)

questions.question: When Diti was pressed by Cupid, what did she do despite her husband's words?

options.text: She caught hold of the clothing of the great brahmana sage

questions.explanation: "...she was pressed by Cupid for sexual satisfaction. She caught hold of the clothing of the great brahmana sage, just like a shameless public prostitute." (SB 3.14.30)

questions.question: After realizing her fault, Diti begged Kasyapa to bless her so that her embryo would not be killed by whom?
questions.explanation: "My dear brahmana, kindly see that my embryo is not killed by Lord Siva, the lord of all living entities, because of the great offense I have committed against him." (SB 3.14.34)

questions.question: Diti described Lord Siva as her brother-in-law because he is the husband of which sister?
questions.explanation: "Let him be pleased with us, since he is my brother-in-law, the husband of my sister Sati." (SB 3.14.36)

questions.question: How many contemptuous sons did Kasyapa foretell would be born of Diti's condemned womb?
questions.explanation: "O haughty one, you will have two contemptuous sons born of your condemned womb." (SB 3.14.39)

questions.question: What did Kasyapa foretell that Diti's sons would do to the three worlds?

options.text: Cause constant lamentation to all the three worlds

questions.explanation: "Unlucky woman, they will cause constant lamentation to all the three worlds!" (SB 3.14.39)

questions.question: According to Kasyapa, who would descend to kill Diti's demoniac sons?
questions.explanation: "...the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is the well-wisher of all living entities, will descend and kill them, just as Indra smashes the mountains with his thunderbolts." (SB 3.14.41)

questions.question: How did Diti react to learning her sons would be killed by the Personality of Godhead with His Sudarsana weapon?
questions.explanation: "It is very good that my sons will be magnanimously killed by the arms of the Personality of Godhead with His Sudarsana weapon." (SB 3.14.42)

questions.question: Kasyapa foretold that which grandson of Diti (son of Hiranyakasipu) would be an approved devotee of the Lord?
questions.explanation: "...one of the sons [Prahlada] of your son [Hiranyakasipu] will be an approved devotee of the Lord, and his fame will be broadcast equally with that of the Personality of Godhead." (SB 3.14.44-45)

questions.question: What did Kasyapa say Diti's grandson would do after quitting the material world?
questions.explanation: "Due to matured devotional service, he will certainly be situated in transcendental ecstasy and will enter the spiritual sky after quitting this material world." (SB 3.14.48)

questions.question: Diti's father's name was ________.
Daksha Prajapati had married ________ of his daughters to Kashyapa Muni.
Diti approached her husband to have children at ________.

options.text: The time when horrible-looking ghosts are visible
The time when Lord Siva travels with his ghost companions

questions.question: Diti, after realizing her fault of not listening to her husband, begged him to bless her so that she may not be cursed by Lord Siva and also Lord Siva ________.

options.text: Is the worshippable Lord of all women
Is the fulfiller of all material desires

questions.question: Kashyapa foretold Diti that the sons in her womb ________.

options.text: Would cause constant lamentation to all the 3 worlds
Would kill poor, faultless living entities, torture women etc,
Will be killed by the Supreme Personality of Godhead

questions.question: Kasyapa also said to Diti that her grandson Prahlad ________.

options.text: Will be the topmost devotee of the Lord and would be the greatest of the great souls
Will be always situated in transcendental ecstasy
Will enter spiritual sky at the end of his life

questions.question: On hearing the future spoken by her husband, Diti ________.
